criteria.scenario: wp0 closes with a 000 plan and one diff-level decade doc per repo, naming the surfaces and candidate mechanisms each is expected to yield
criteria.expectedEvidence: ls plus head of devlog/260828_upstream3/*.md showing non-outline content
criteria.capturedEvidence: devlog/260828_upstream3 holds 000_plan.md plus decade docs 010 codex, 020 hermes, 030 openclaw, 040 ship, and 050 closeout. The plan names the surfaces and candidate mechanisms per repo and states the inventory-not-repository limitation as an explicit non-goal. Committed in 6ffa7b4.

criteria.scenario: Each repo has a frozen commit inventory and a frozen open-issue inventory, both reproducible from the recorded commands
criteria.expectedEvidence: wc -l of devlog/260828_upstream3/inv/* plus the grep and gh search commands in the plan
